text:
Anna: Quick check — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow 10:00am PT. Who's taking branch origination and the initial changelog bump? Need backport owners too. @jamal @oliver
Jamal: I can take branch creation + smoke CI. I'll create release/1.16 and open the tracking issue. Any objections to version bump to 1.16.0-rc1?
Oliver: I'll own the changelog nudge and organize the backport queue. Can we set cutoff at 9:00am PT (1 hour before cut)? :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled: branch-cut job queued for 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z
Sophie: Heads up — there's an open PR that needs manual merge because of flaky tests: #4829. If that lands after cutoff, are we ok to schedule for the next patch?
Marco: Prefer to include #4829 in this cut — it's mostly a doc + version-fix. If someone can help debug the flaky test I can re-run. @tests-team
Anna: If it's flaky we should exclude unless someone volunteers to fix today. Oliver, can you make a short list of required backports so I can triage priority?
Oliver: List posted in the tracking issue: frontend-freeze (2 PRs), metrics-rename (1 PR), infra-fix #4829. I'll add label `release/1.16-backport` and assign owners.
Jamal: When I create the branch I'll also open a tracking issue and assign backport owners. Template I'm using:
```
Branch: release/1.16
Cut time: 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z
Cut owner: Jamal
Backport label: release/1.16-backport
```
Sophie: Quick policy question — are we still 'no non-doc changes after cutoff' or do infra fixes get exceptions? Need clarity so teams know whether to rush.
Anna: Policy: only critical infra/security fixes allowed after cutoff and they require two approvers. Non-critical changes go into the next patch.
Marco: :thumbsup: I'll try to patch #4829 today if I can get someone to help with the flaky test.
ci-bot: CI status: default branch tests 87% pass, flaky-suite at 74% — recommend manual CI run for #4829.
Oliver: I'll coordinate a manual run. @Maya (QA) can you prioritize flake triage this afternoon?
Maya (QA): On it. ETA ~2 hours for triage and a manual run.
Anna: Cool. Jamal, when branch is created please ping #eng-oncall and drop the branch URL + tracking issue here. I'll run the preflight checklist at 9:15am PT.
Jamal: Will do. Also reminder to update the internal release-notes doc: /docs/releases/1.16 (internal). I'll add owners and initial notes.
Oliver: One more ask — let's soft-freeze major dependency bumps. Last minute grpc bump bit us last release.
Sophie: Agreed. No dep bumps after cutoff unless explicitly approved in Slack + two approvers.
Anna: Thanks all. Backport owners: add PR links to the tracking issue as you open them. I'll do final triage and cut sign-off 9:15am PT.
Jamal: Branch creation + tracking issue will be posted shortly.
